title: Smart Shopping List Organizer
description:
Shopping lists are written in the order items come to mind, so in the store people walk back and forth and forget things. An assistant should turn a free-text note into a list grouped by category and sorted in the order of the aisles of the user's own store.

Constraints: notes are short and informal ("2 kg potatoes, milk and 6 eggs", "stuff for pancakes"); there is no public API for store layouts, so the user describes the layout once; the basic function should work offline without an AI service, with an LLM as an option for messy text.
goals:
• Read item, quantity and unit from typical notes
  • Assign every item to a store category, and mark unknown items as "other" instead of guessing
  • Merge duplicate items with the same unit
  • Sort the list by a per-store aisle order that the user can edit
  • Keep the rule-based mode working without network access
